work_packages.title: M0 public DNA sequence geometry experiment
work_packages.question: Can a declared hyperbolic representation improve a pinned public DNA sequence classification task over matched Euclidean and random controls?
non_claims: This work does not evaluate personal, clinical, disease, longevity, intervention, tissue, or therapeutic claims.
A performance result would not establish biological mechanism.

work_packages.title: Offline signed release-artifact verification
work_packages.question: Can an offline verifier bind a release manifest, DSSE attestation, and public-key policy with explicit verified, fail, and unverifiable outcomes?
non_claims: A signed artifact verifies only the declared release identity and file binding, not scientific validity.
